verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU, and user-defined event-triggered automation rules are a software or workflow-platform capability, so this story is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the product shipping such a rules engine. cuML's automatic GPU/CPU dispatch is a library behavior, not user-defined event rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
